title: COF photocatalysis: H2O2 production coupled with organic transformation
description: Literature screening for a review on COF (and sibling frameworks) that produce H2O2 photocatalytically while converting an organic substrate.

object.note: The product slot. Every dimension query is ANDed with this. H 2 O 2（带空格）是必须的：接口把下标渲染成空格，实测两篇金集阳性因此漏判。

dimensions.note: CTF is counted inside COF by this review's convention, but must be flagged in notes.
The acronym CMP alone is ambiguous (chemical mechanical polishing), so only the full phrase is queried.

extraQueries.why: The API renders subscripts as spaces (Bi 2 O 2 S), so a literal query misses it.
extraQueries.query: (Bi2O2S OR "Bi 2 O 2 S" OR CuInS2) AND ("hydrogen peroxide" OR H2O2)

extraQueries.why: Class-C papers consume H2O2 in situ and never name it in the abstract.
extraQueries.query: ("carbon nitride" OR C3N4) AND methane AND ethanol

checks.note: a sacrificial agent, or a substrate doubling as the solvent; its yield is not comparable to a coupled run
often starts a second experiment; check whether both products ever appear in one figure

no 'happens at the same time' language anywhere in the abstract. Measured on this gold set: coupled appears 3x, concurrent 2x, simultaneous only 1x — matching the single word 'simultaneous' would flag 5 of the 7 positives

names a step sequence and then consumes H2O2 downstream; may be a cascade rather than a coupled system. Deliberately narrow: it only catches abstracts that say 'step' — a cascade that never says so is indistinguishable from coupling here

output.scopeDirective: Coverage is reported on scope=COF only; sibling systems and composites are discussed but never counted into the COF denominator.

noiseTerms.why: 中性样本里它在池子(36%)比在阳性(33%)还常见；它是这个领域的常识，不是判据
通用的指标说法，出现在几乎所有产率论文里

polarityTerms.why: 双向词：without sacrificial agent 是好事，sacrificial-agent-triggered 是坏事。实测池子里 33 篇提到它，24 篇否定形式、9 篇肯定形式，lift 因此被抵消到 1.21

noteTerms.label: 原位 / operando 表征
noteTerms.why: 阳性 3/6 出现、池子 52%。读这篇之前值得知道它有没有实况证据——决定它是「推测机理」还是「看见中间体」。

noteTerms.label: 定量产率数据
noteTerms.why: 阳性 5/6 出现、池子 50%。没有定量数据的「高性能」不适合当综述里的证据。

noteTermNotes: 2026-11-19 实测 9 个「值得看一眼」的信号，只有 in-situ(3/6) 与定量产率(5/6) 在阳性里出现；同位素标记、AQY、DFT、三相界面、自由基捕获、循环稳定性、流动反应器都是 0/6。但金集只有 6 篇有摘要，0/6 更可能是样本不足，不是这些信号没价值——等正例攒到 ≥10 篇再复测一次，别拿 6 篇定词表。

couplingPhrases.why: 最直接的耦合声明；阳性 2/6、池子 9/120
「同时发生」，对应 A 型载流子耦合
集成式表达，多半是 B/C 型
「把底物变成有价值产物」——这正是判「真耦合」的核心词

couplingPhrasesNote: 这些不是统计出来的，来自 skills/criteria-compiler/references/rules.md 第三节的原文用词表。用法：与对象词组成 co-occur（同句出现）判据——「H2O2 … coupled with X」才是真耦合声明，两段各说各的不能算。
